agyos_skill.intent: Master runbook for production-grade, free-first AI engineering setups using AGY CLI exclusively. Covers environment audits, MCP server wiring, specialist skill catalog routing, Supabase/Vercel/Cloudflare integration, free-tier cost controls, and automated verification.
agyos_skill.instructions: A discipline and runbook for establishing and maintaining a production-grade, free-first AI development environment using AGY CLI (Antigravity) exclusively as the coding agent. 1. **Free-First Priority**: Prioritize genuinely free and open-source solutions. Never create paid resources, enable automatic billing, or exceed free-tier boundaries without explicit authorization. 2. **AGY-Native**: Rely exclusively on Antigravity CLI (`agy`). Do not install, invoke, or depend on Codex or Claude Code. 3. **Idempotence & Safety**: Never overwrite existing configurations without backups. Never use blind `curl | bash`. 4. **Machine Evidence Required**: Every verification step must execute real commands and report actual exit codes (PASS, FAIL, SKIPPED, or AUTH REQUIRED). Execute system discovery before applying any changes: 1. **OS & Kernel**: Check distribution (`cat /etc/os-release`), architecture (`uname -m`), kernel release. 2. **Resources**: Inspect CPU (`nproc`), RAM (`free -h`), disk space (`df -h /`), GPU availability (`nvidia-smi`). 3. **Toolchains**: Verify versions of Node.js (`node -v`), npm, Bun, Python (`python3 --version`), `uv`, Git, GitHub CLI (`gh`), Vercel CLI (`vercel`), Supabase CLI (`supabase`), and Wrangler (`wrangler`). 4. **AGY Configuration**: Inspect `agy --version`, `agy mcp list`, `agy plugin list`, and `~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json`. Route development tasks to the appropriate specialist runbooks within AGY: - **Next.js & React**: `nextjs-best-practices`, `nextjs-app-router-patterns`, `react-performance`. - **Styling & Tokens**: `tailwind-design-system`, `design-system-architect`, `radix-ui-design-system`. - **Animation & Polish**: `emil-design-eng` (concentric border radii, frequency-based timing, transform/opacity only), `high-end-visual-design`. - **Accessibility**: `frontend-a11y`, `wcag-audit-patterns`. - **FastAPI / Python**: `fastapi-pro`, `fastapi-router-py`, `pydantic-models-py`. - **Node.js / Edge**: `nodejs-backend-patterns`, `hono`, `bun-development`. - **API Contracts**: `api-design-principles`, `api-security-best-practices`, `auth-implementation-patterns`. - **Queues & Jobs**: `bullmq-specialist`, `trigger-dev`. - **Postgres & Supabase**: `postgres-best-practices`, `supabase-postgres-best-practices`, `nextjs-supabase-auth`. - **Schema & Migrations**: `architecture-database-design`, `drizzle-orm-expert`, `prisma-expert`, `database-migrations-sql-migrations`. - **Hosting & Edge**: `vercel-deployment`, `cloudflare-workers-expert`. - **CI/CD & Workflows**: `github-actions-templates`, `github-workflow-automation`. - **Secrets & Validation**: `secrets-management`, `varlock`, `deployment-validation-config-validate`. - **Audits**: `security-review`, `top-web-vulnerabilities`, `differential-review`.
